buyer.0.title: Welcome to Verdaxis!
buyer.0.content: The compliance-first marketplace for verified sustainable marine fuels. Let's take a quick tour of your Buyer Console.
buyer.1.title: Post Buying Interest
buyer.1.content: Start from the Command Center when you are ready to post a bid, review active orders, or act on items that need attention.
buyer.2.title: Market Radar
buyer.2.content: Market Radar tracks product, port, and availability-window slices so you can return to liquidity changes without treating it as a second orderbook.
buyer.3.title: Marketplace Action
buyer.3.content: Marketplace is where buyers browse verified supply, filter by market slice, post bids, and respond to live asks.
buyer.4.title: Executable Orderbook
buyer.4.content: Use the orderbook to inspect bid and ask depth for the selected product, delivery point, and availability window before trading.
buyer.5.title: Market Terminal
buyer.5.content: The Market Terminal combines live orderbook depth with indicative market intelligence for the selected product and port.
buyer.6.title: Indicative Forward Curve
buyer.6.content: The Forward Curve is indicative. It visualises benchmark mid price and bid/ask context, but it is not an executable futures board.
buyer.7.title: Market Activity Feed
buyer.7.content: Follow new orders, benchmark moves, and matched trades. Activity relevant to your organisation is highlighted.
buyer.8.title: Price Alerts
buyer.8.content: Set threshold alerts for the selected product and port so you know when the market reaches your target.
buyer.9.title: Market Radar Workspace
buyer.9.content: Open Market Radar to manage tracked slices and pinned orders you want to monitor after posting bids.
buyer.10.title: Regulations
buyer.10.content: Review compliance status and regulatory exposure, including FuelEU Maritime, EU ETS, and fleet readiness.
buyer.11.title: My Trades
buyer.11.content: Track orders and completed trades, including confirmation status and trade history.
buyer.12.title: Notifications
buyer.12.content: Stay updated on trade confirmations, price alerts, and compliance deadlines. You're all set.
supplier.0.title: Welcome to Verdaxis!
supplier.0.content: The compliance-first marketplace for verified sustainable marine fuels. Let's take a quick tour of your Supplier Console.
supplier.1.title: Post Supply
supplier.1.content: Start from the Command Center when you are ready to post an ask, review buyer demand signals, or act on items that need attention.
supplier.2.title: Market Radar
supplier.2.content: Market Radar tracks product, port, and availability-window slices so suppliers can monitor demand without leaving the orderbook flow.
supplier.3.title: Marketplace Action
supplier.3.content: Marketplace is where suppliers review buyer demand, post asks, and respond to bid-side liquidity in the selected slice.
supplier.4.title: Executable Orderbook
supplier.4.content: Use the orderbook to inspect bid and ask depth for the selected product, delivery point, and availability window before quoting supply.
supplier.5.title: Market Terminal
supplier.5.content: The Market Terminal combines live orderbook depth with indicative market intelligence for the selected product and port.
supplier.6.title: Indicative Forward Curve
supplier.6.content: The Forward Curve is indicative. It visualises benchmark mid price and bid/ask context, but it is not an executable futures board.
supplier.7.title: Market Activity Feed
supplier.7.content: Follow new orders, benchmark moves, and matched trades as the market updates.
supplier.8.title: Price Alerts
supplier.8.content: Set threshold alerts to track when a market reaches your target pricing level.
supplier.9.title: Market Radar Workspace
supplier.9.content: Open Market Radar to manage tracked slices and pinned orders you want to monitor after posting asks.
supplier.10.title: Regulations
supplier.10.content: Review regulatory status and buyer compliance drivers, including FuelEU Maritime and EU ETS.
supplier.11.title: Analytics
supplier.11.content: Review performance trends and market position to refine supply strategy.
supplier.12.title: My Trades
supplier.12.content: Track completed and in-progress trades, delivery confirmations, and trade history.
supplier.13.title: Notifications
supplier.13.content: Real-time alerts for new orders, price changes, and platform updates. You're all set.
